note: fluid-functionalism.vercel.app — its own sitemap points at the canonical www.fluidfunctionalism.com (pages live there; /docs/<name>). Each registry item's own `docs` field names its page, so: plain items use /docs/<name> as-is; the Base UI flavors ('Accordion (Base UI)', slug *-base) are documented on the same page as the Radix one (the page has a 'Built on Radix UI or Base UI … Switch in the right panel' toggle) → '-base' is stripped; scroll-area/-base live on /docs/scrollbars; queued-stack on /docs/input-message; the sidebar blocks (sidebar-workspace-header, sidebar-user-footer, sidebar-app) on /docs/sidebar; dialog-sidebar on /docs/dialog. Fills 48 of the 53 items; mobile-drawer(-base), file-thumbnail and sidebar-search-field/sidebar-inset-topbar have no page (their `docs` is just the home page), so they stay url-less. robots.txt disallows only named AI bots for * (our UA is allowed, no rule for *). Pages carry a generic <title> 'Fluid Functionalism' but a real <h1> (Accordion, Scrollbars, …); unknown /docs paths 404, so the soft-404 guard stays off.
